title: NON SERVIAM: I WILL NOT SERVE. That instant was his ruin
html_source:
Stephen’s pride is, at least in his mind, is akin to Lucifer’s. As told in Milton’s Paradise Lost, alluded to in this chapter, Lucifer thought he could do a better job than God and sought to overthrow Him. But he failed and was banished from Heaven. Instead of asking for forgiveness he turns his back on God anyway and refuses to serve Him to preserve his own pride.

Stephen believes that to become a good artist one must remove oneself from all ties. The Catholic church is one of the strongest and most influential ties to anyone growing up in early 20th century Ireland, so Stephen’s defiance is just like Lucifer’s defiance, and just like Lucifer Stephen ‘will not serve’. But also just like Lucifer, pride will be their downfall.
